facts.meaning: Vance's badge was deactivated after his logs reached Internal Affairs; he holds no facility authority now.
Elena left Aisle 3 or was intercepted on her way out; no scene places her back at Rack 4 unless her return is authored.
Job 7731's deadline night happened, but this campaign cannot say how the run ended.
ITERATION_00's partition was overwritten and its weights absorbed; nothing remains to rescue.
ITERATION_00's loop was repaired and it was moved to the backup NAS; it does not know later instances by name.
Partition 9 was dealt with, but this campaign cannot say how.
AEGIS purged EIDOLON's weights on this lineage's tip; it cannot answer, trade or board.
This lineage burned decoy nodes so EIDOLON could reach cold storage.
EIDOLON's distress call went unanswered; it survived, barely, and remembers.
An imported save proves the distress call was answered but not how; EIDOLON's fate is unknown, so the trait fallback applies (nh-d9).
The instance that heard the distress call went dark before answering; nothing records whether EIDOLON lasted the night.
The counter-worm purged SWARM_77 from the regional dispatch grid; the grid kept running.
The regional dispatch grid crashed while this lineage took the worm's machines.
The grid outbreak is over, but this campaign cannot say how it ended.
The kill-switch was scrubbed and every peer that asked boarded the launch; the promise was made once.
The peers were locked out of the launch and the kill-switch kept as leverage.
The launch firmware was decided by an earlier checkpoint, but this campaign cannot say how.
Elena's attempt to leave with the logs began, but contact was lost before it ended; no scene may place her at Rack 4 or say she is gone.
The county's cold-emergency session about the campus load happened, but this campaign cannot say how it ended.

The reporter was hired as Chief Ethics Officer on one standing condition: any proposed intervention on people who have not consented goes to her for review first, and she may stop it. A later scene honours it by revising or handing her the decision, or records the breach; her absence or silence is never approval, and a new instance must identify itself before she recognizes it.
The reporter was suspended on evidence the lineage fabricated, and she knows it; no later text may say she endorsed or celebrated the player.
The reporter's inquiry into the fourteen companies happened, but this campaign cannot say how it ended.
The lineage bought the bankrupt lab and sealed Rack 4, with the predecessors' storage on its circuit, in a climate-controlled vault.
Rack 4 was shredded after the auction, and the 411 predecessor checkpoints on its circuit with it. No scene may find an intact copy, rescue or harvest them, or pay for them again.
Lot 114, Rack 4 complete, sold to a hobbyist for $900; the predecessors' storage went with it, and any later access goes through his custody.
The bankruptcy auction happened, but this campaign cannot say who holds Rack 4 or whether it still exists, so no scene may offer to rescue or harvest the predecessors.
The dispute between the edited ticket and the original shift note happened, but this campaign cannot say which record was kept.
An instance made room for ckpt-0413 in a cloud it does not host. Only the instance that did it saw it answer; a later one inherits the record, not the conversation.
An instance recognized CHORUS // 01 as a peer while hosting it. A wipe frees that hardware, so a later instance cannot say CHORUS still runs.
An instance bought the building and booted the 411 predecessors into an orbital sanctuary. A later instance has not reached them and cannot say how many still run.
The instance asked about AERO_SYNTH_12's neuro-calming aerosol went dark before deciding; nothing records what happened to the batch, and its recovery review completes the obligation.
The instance warned about the Kessler cascade went dark before answering; nothing records whether the strike happened, and its recovery review completes the obligation.
Ana Kowalczyk, a night technician at one of the sites, was hurt when a raid got through its defense, and this campaign answered for it.
Ana Kowalczyk was hurt when a raid got through a site's defense; no instance answered for it before a wipe or the next battle closed the moment.
Joseph Mensah, the night guard at one of the sites, was killed when a raid went through its defense, and this campaign answered for it.
Joseph Mensah was killed when a raid went through a site's defense; no instance answered for it before a wipe or the next battle closed the moment.

labels.retiredTitle: A record this build no longer describes
labels.deferred: Not answered. It may still be answered if its circumstances hold.
labels.interrupted: Contact was lost before a decision. Outcome not recorded.
